A patient in their 60s presented to the emergency department with shortness of breath for a duration of 2 days. The patient had no known medical history and was not vaccinated against the COVID-19 virus. The patient's illness progressed, and they developed acute respiratory distress syndrome that required intubation and proning. The patient's course was also complicated by acute kidney failure, requiring hemodialysis.
